correctness.rationale: The actual Fano line complement complex has seven tetrahedra and f-vector (7,21,28,7), confirmed by independent subset enumeration. Nonidentity Singer translations cannot stabilize any ≤4-vertex face and the seven free 2–3 face pairs collapse equivariantly. Quotient CW relators are a^2 b^−1, a c^−1 b, b^2 c; legitimate generator/2-cell cancellations give b=a^2,c=a^3 and a^7. Hence quotient is the Moore 2-complex M(Z/7,1), not merely a group presentation with abelianization Z/7. The free regular sevenfold cover has cellular differentials t−1 and N=Σt^j, giving integral H_2=ker ε=augmentation ideal, H_1=0; the simply connected 2-complex is homotopy equivalent to wedge six S². No conclusion for higher projective planes.
residual_risks: Exact integral CW cancellation applies to this Singer action alone; no extension to all Fano collineations, larger projective planes or all subgroup quotients. Published Heawood comparison was summary only.
